steps: On a laptop as organizer, start November concert for four weeks with 19:00 to 22:00 and 10:00 to 13:00
On your phone as a member, open it, add an evening from the pre-filled times, choose no more than 2 and send your answer
Back on the laptop, open the request and press Repeat request
